subject.title: [Bug]: Isolated cron agentTurn fails with 'setup timed out before runner start' — all fallback models exhausted on 2026.5.12

question: Should OpenClaw change the default isolated cron setup watchdog from a fixed 60s ceiling to the bounded job-timeout-derived behavior proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96219?
rationale: The code fix is focused, but the default behavior tradeoff is product-facing: slower cold starts would stop failing at 60s, while genuinely stuck setup could hold cron capacity longer before cleanup.

options.title: Accept bounded longer setup
options.body: Land the focused PR or equivalent behavior so long isolated cron setup can use a bounded portion of the job timeout budget.

options.title: Keep 60s fixed default
options.body: Reject the behavior change and instead require users to avoid slow isolated agentTurn cron setups or move work to command jobs/provider-specific fixes.

options.title: Require an operator knob first
options.body: Ask for a configurable watchdog policy before changing the default, accepting the added config surface and upgrade documentation burden.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded longer setup
recommendation.body: Land the focused PR or equivalent behavior so long isolated cron setup can use a bounded portion of the job timeout budget.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate from history for the cron watchdog owner-boundary and default-behavior tradeoff.
